assessment: This study will be of interest to researchers studying climate change and Arctic tundra systems. The authors apply LAVESI, a machine-intensive and spatially explicit simulation of individual Siberian trees at the tundra-forest boundary, to call attention to the rapid reduction in the tundra biome as climate warming pushes forests toward the Arctic Ocean. This detailed modelling study predicts dramatic losses of tundra area by the middle of the millennium even under an ambitious climate mitigation scenario and highlights considerable risks of extinction.
